sample_farthest_points_uniform: sample K uniformly distributed points from a batch of point clouds using iterative farthest point sampling
sample_farthest_points_random_start: sample K points from a point cloud starting from a random point instead of the first point
sample_farthest_points_heterogeneous: sample points from a batch of heterogeneous point clouds with varying lengths using a lengths tensor
sample_farthest_points_naive: run the naive pure Python farthest point sampling implementation on a batch of point clouds for debugging
sample_farthest_points_variable_K: sample a different number of points K per batch element by passing K as a list or tensor
